definitions.full: H3837. Laban II. לָבָן 54 proper name, masculine son of Bethuel , brother of Rebekah, and father-in-law of Jacob ( ᵐ5 Λαβαν ), Gen 24:29 (twice in verse); 24:50 ; 27:43 ; 28:2 , 5 17 t. J (Gen 29, 30, 31, 32); 29:15-16 , 19 , 21 , 22 , 26 18 t. E (Gen 31, 32, ׳ל הָאֲרַמִּי 31:24 ); 25:20 ( ׳ל הָאֲרַמִּי ) 28:5 ( id. ), also 28:2 ; 29:24 , 29 ; 46:18 , 25 (all P). III. לָבָן proper name, of a location , connected with desert-journey of Israelites Deut 1:1 , ᵐ5 Λοβαν ; possibly = לִבְנָה 2 , q. v.
